g.text: Postgres 18, as of migration 20261030143522 (one squashed init). PK = primary key, FK = foreign key. Source of truth: db/migrations/*.sql (db/schema.sql is generated).
All times are timestamptz (stored as instants); the database and every app session use TimeZone = UTC.
schema ctis — what we fetched (or seeded) from CTIS
One row per ingestion run, so every snapshot traces back to a run
args jsonb what the run was asked for
started_at timestamptz when the run began
finished_at timestamptz null while still running
error text why the run failed
check: status = running <=> finished_at is null
Every trial we have ever seen, whether or not it changed
PK ct_number text EU CT number 2025-522750-39-00
first_seen_at timestamptz first time we fetched it
last_seen_at timestamptz latest fetch, even if unchanged
Change history: a row only when content changed; never updated
FK ct_number text -> trial: which trial
FK fetch_run_id bigint -> fetch_run: run that wrote it
fetched_at timestamptz clock time of this insert
content_hash bytea(32) sha256 of canonical JSON
Newest snapshot per trial: what most queries should read
SELECT DISTINCT ON (ct_number) * ... ORDER BY fetched_at DESC
Written by dbmate: which migrations are applied
PK version varchar migration id, e.g. 20261030143522
schema ref — CTIS code lists (decode numbers in payload)
code smallint PK · label text UNIQUE
code smallint PK · label text UNIQUE
11 rows · 4 = Phase II, 5 = Phase III, 6 = Phase IV
code smallint PK · label text UNIQUE
3 rows · 1 = EEA only, 3 = EEA and non-EEA
code smallint PK · label text UNIQUE
code smallint PK · label text UNIQUE
code smallint PK · label text UNIQUE
code smallint PK · label text UNIQUE
7 rows · 103 = Summary of results, 46 = Lay summary
30 EEA rows · iso2 PK, name UNIQUE, is_eu boolean
ctis: data fetched from CTIS (history kept)
ref: fixed code lists, loaded by migration
dashed box: view (no data of its own)
Rows of a CTIS search export (one file = one search, e.g. PIP); never updated
FK ct_number text -> trial: which trial
FK fetch_run_id bigint -> fetch_run: seed run
captured_on date day CTIS made the export
content_hash bytea(32) sha256 of canonical JSON
payload jsonb (lz4) CSV row as in the file
schema gold — hand-checked answers we compare against
Bruckner et al.'s final verdict per trial (277 rows); never updated
PK ct_number text -> trial: one row per trial
FK fetch_run_id bigint -> fetch_run: seed run
days_to_results integer only if reported fully
comment text reviewers' note, if any
content_hash bytea(32) sha256 of canonical JSON
payload jsonb CSV row as in the file
verdict: reported fully on time / reported fully late /
gold: hand-checked labels, loaded from files
Their manual review: one row per results document (206)
PK ct_number text -> trial: one per document
FK fetch_run_id bigint -> fetch_run: seed run
results_posted_on date results appeared in CTIS
reviewers_agreed boolean first two agreed upfront
content_hash bytea(32) sha256 of canonical JSON
payload jsonb CSV row, bad bytes as U+FFFD
Each reviewer's answer per part (444 rows: 206 + 201 + 37)
PK reviewer text first / second / third
outcomes boolean primary outcome results given
asked_to_check boolean wanted a second look
NULL = part left blank. third: 37 documents,
mostly where first and second disagreed
